query: What business models and customers do these companies describe?

per_column.name: business_model_type
per_column.rationale: Directly answers the 'business model' half of the query and gives a well-distributed categorical axis for grouping. Sample values (venture_capital for 5AM/Accel, professional_services for 280 Group, consumer_app for 23andMe, SaaS for Addepar) are sound readings of the descriptions.

per_column.name: primary_customer_segment
per_column.rationale: Directly answers the 'customers' half of the query and provides a strong grouping axis. Segments are well-warranted inferences (investor_founder for VCs, B2B_enterprise for Addepar/280 Group, B2C_consumer for 23andMe), though some are reasonable inference rather than explicit.

per_column.name: industry_vertical
per_column.rationale: Adds a genuine, distinct grouping dimension complementary to business model and customer. Mostly grounded (fintech for Addepar, healthtech for 23andMe), and silent rows sensibly marked Unknown/NULL. Labeling 5AM Ventures as healthtech_biotech is a defensible read of 'life science companies'.

per_column.name: core_product_service_category
per_column.rationale: Provides a finer product-level axis, but overlaps substantially with business_model_type (investment_fund<->venture_capital, staffing_consulting<->professional_services, software_platform<->SaaS), reducing incremental leverage. Also the AI_ML_product tag for 23andMe is not supported by the description of personalized ancestry/health reports.

per_column.name: delivery_mode
per_column.rationale: Delivery/channel is a legitimate new axis relevant to business model. Values are largely reasonable, but some are inferred beyond the text (e.g., in_person_services for VCs whose text is silent on delivery), which is a warranted-but-thin inference rather than direct evidence.

judge.rationale: The added columns collectively give strong, distinct axes (model, customer, vertical, product, delivery) that directly serve the query about business models and customers. Grounding is generally sound with sensible Unknown/NULL handling for silent rows. Minor deductions: core_product_service_category is partly redundant with business_model_type, and a few values (e.g., AI_ML_product for 23andMe) assert specifics not supported by the source text.
